newsitem.title: USA: Fla. 518 MW Northside power unit seen back Monday.
newsitem.headline: Fla. 518 MW Northside power unit seen back Monday.

text.p: A 518 megawatt (MW) unit at the Northside generating station in Jacksonville, Fla., was expected to resume operation Monday following seasonal maintenance, the operator said Thursday.
"We should have it back Monday afternoon," said a spokesman for Jacksonville Electric Authority (JEA).
The Northside unit 3, which uses natural gas to generate electricity, was shut earlier this month.
The entire Northside complex has a rated capacity of 1,231 MW.
